tagline: Post deal alerts to Slack and update Salesforce records from chat messages
metaTitle: Salesforce + Slack Integration: Deal Alerts in Slack
metaDescription: Keep the sales team on top of every deal from Slack. GAIA celebrates closed deals, flags at-risk ones, and updates Salesforce from chat. See the setup steps.
intro:
Revenue teams live in Slack but their deal data lives in Salesforce, and the gap between the two means critical deal events go unnoticed until someone checks the CRM. A deal closes and the broader team finds out hours later. A deal goes cold and no one escalates because the signal was buried in a report nobody opened.

GAIA links the two so deal intelligence flows into the conversations where decisions are made. Won deals trigger immediate announcements in the revenue channel. At-risk opportunities generate alerts to the account owner. High-value pipeline updates surface in leadership channels. And when a rep needs to update a record quickly, they can do it from Slack without switching tabs.

This integration is essential for high-velocity sales teams where deal momentum depends on real-time information, and for revenue leaders who need pipeline visibility without pulling reports manually.

useCases.title: Celebrate closed deals in Slack automatically
useCases.description: When an opportunity is marked Closed Won, GAIA posts a deal win announcement to the revenue Slack channel with the deal name, value, account, and rep, giving the team immediate visibility and morale.

useCases.title: Alert account owners about at-risk deals
useCases.description: When a deal's close date passes without progressing or is moved back multiple times, GAIA sends a DM to the account owner and a channel alert to the sales manager to trigger intervention.

useCases.title: Update Salesforce fields from Slack
useCases.description: Reps can message GAIA to update deal fields (close date, stage, next step, amount) without opening Salesforce, reducing CRM friction for field reps and fast-moving deal cycles.

useCases.title: Weekly pipeline digest in the revenue channel
useCases.description: GAIA posts a structured weekly pipeline digest to the revenue channel listing deals by stage, total pipeline value, deals closing this week, and deals that have not been updated in over a week.

useCases.title: New lead alerts for high-priority accounts
useCases.description: When a new lead is created for a target account or high-value company, GAIA posts an immediate alert to the designated channel so the right rep can respond before the lead goes cold.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Slack workspace. Map pipeline stages and record types to channels for notifications.

howItWorks.step: Configure alert rules and channel mappings
howItWorks.description: Define which events (stage changes, deal wins, overdue dates, new leads) trigger messages, and specify the target channel or user for each alert type.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your revenue team informed in real time
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors the CRM for deal events and posts structured notifications to chat immediately, while also accepting update requests from chat to keep deal data current.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post Salesforce alerts to different Slack channels for different deal sizes?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to route alerts based on deal value — enterprise deals to a dedicated channel, SMB deals to another — so the right audience sees each notification.

faqs.question: What fields can be updated by messaging GAIA?
faqs.answer: GAIA supports updating standard fields — stage, close date, amount, next step, description — and custom fields via natural language commands in chat. The update is reflected in the CRM immediately.

faqs.question: Can GAIA notify the full account team, not just the deal owner?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can notify all users mapped to the account team for a given deal, ensuring everyone with a stake in the account is informed of significant events.
